title: Art. 15.1.3.5 — Procedures for Air Navigation Services - Air Traffic Management (Doc 4444), Chapter 15 - Procedures Related to Emergencies, Communication Failure and Contingencies, 15.1 Emergency Procedures, 15.1.3 Unlawful interference and aircraft bomb threat, 15.1.3.5
content: The ATS unit in communication with the aircraft shall ascertain the intentions of the flight crew and report those intentions to other ATS units which may be concerned with the flight.
